sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, 'Jump Forward' is a game about timing and strategy. The game's main mechanic revolves around the player's ability to jump and control their character's height and momentum. The longer you hold down the jump button, the higher you'll jump, but this also increases your risk of falling off a platform or being caught by a deadly trap. This delicate balance requires precision and timing, making it easy to get stuck or fall off a platform. However, mastering this mechanic is key to success, and as you progress through the levels, you'll find yourself adapting to increasingly difficult challenges.

One of the things that sets 'Jump Forward' apart from other arcade games is its use of momentum. As you jump and land on different platforms, you'll build up momentum, allowing you to reach new heights and traverse the level with ease. However, this momentum can also be a double-edged sword, as it increases your risk of falling off a platform or getting caught in a trap. This adds a new layer of strategy to the game, as you'll need to carefully consider when to build up momentum and when to hold back.

As you progress through the levels, you'll also encounter a variety of obstacles and challenges that require specific strategies to overcome. These challenges include moving platforms, disappearing platforms, and even enemies that will try to stop you from reaching the end of the level. Each level presents a unique set of challenges, requiring you to adapt your strategy and think on your feet if you hope to succeed.
